title: Race against time: 2 men trapped in Zamboanga Sur flooded mining tunnel

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Authorities on Saturday continue to race against time for two men trapped by floods at a mining tunnel in Barangay Dilud of Dumingag town, Zamboanga del Sur since Wednesday, Sept. 30. Responders have launched search and rescue operations for the duo at the abandoned mining tunnel. As of Saturday afternoon, the Dumingag municipal police station said the two miners were not yet located. Captain Derf Jay Maquinta, spokesperson for the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office (ZSPPO), said personnel from the Dumingag municipal police station responded to a report from a concerned citizen regarding the […]...
